richter.inletPeakNote: The published profile has a 0.3 m/s peak, inconsistent with the stated mean (0.15 m/s) and with the preprint's 0.2 m/s and Re = 40; the reference values are reproduced only with a 0.2 m/s peak, so 0.3 m/s is taken to be an error (not yet confirmed by the author).

referenceProvenance.citation: Thomas Richter (2012), Goal-oriented error estimation for fluid-structure interaction problems, Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering 223-224, 28-42, doi:10.1016/j.cma.2012.02.014
referenceProvenance.detail: Published Table 3 gives Fx = 1.33 N and ux(A) = 5.95e-5 m, each with a stated accuracy of 1%, extrapolated from the finest three of five uniformly refined Q1 levels. The 2011 preprint gives the same extrapolations more precisely (Table 6): Fx = 1.327 +/- 0.01 N and ux(A) = 5.924e-5 +/- 1e-7 m; its Table 5 lists the five levels.
